verdict.rationale: Docs show Codex offers CLI, IDE extension, MCP, and cloud task features, and API key access is technically supported (codex-gh-4), but direct evidence shows newest capabilities lag behind the UI: 'gpt-5.3-codex isn't available on the API yet' (codex-comm-5), and API key usage requires extra setup vs the primary ChatGPT-account flow (codex-gh-3, codex-gh-4), undermining full UI/API parity claims.
